notes.title: Vengeance 2.2 Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hey Soldiers,[/h2][/b]
Welcome to the first update in 2022! As you probably know 99% of the Team is currently working on our new game Projekt Z, but sometimes we find some time to work on Vengeance. With today's update, we will improve the game's base movement, maps, and gunplay.

[b]Download Size (Windows): 2.6GB
Download Size (Linux): 2.5GB[/b]

[b][h3]New Content[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added New Weapon "VAHAN"[/b]
The VAHAN is an assault rifle of Soviet/Armenian origin and was designed by Engineer and Firearms Designer Vahan S. Manasian. The weapon dates back to 1952 as the MBC-2 when Manasian was a soldier in the Soviet Army. As of 2009, The VAHAN rifle has not yet been tested by the Armenian government.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/34ef49a051625c07a8acf7acc6e22476f954ef85.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added New Map "Icebreaker"[/b]
A Cargoplane from the USA crashed in Russian territory. It's your task as the USE to defend the cargo from the resistance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/6bdcff9ee6c980398bf4c6854cc16bf012d19acb.jpg[/img]

[/list]

[b][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Construction Site Rework[/b]
In version 2.0, we reworked the map Construction Site, and at the time it got released, we were happy with the design we came up with, but after a bit of time, we decided to solve some of the design flaws we found. You and your team fight for a construction site where the USE placed a military base to push back the resistance who captured the town a few weeks prior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/55435f839c090fe5f1e4aee404fb46c4af41c11d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/995eedf3f2a305feecc9d51a0122395880a7b5fd.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Area314 Rework[/b]
For the Area314 rework, we decided to change the visual style of the map. It now has a much darker and colder tone. We also fixed some flaws regarding cover and unfair advantage points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/d0ffc16314740b5048a28a23b5a497790a3295f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/f24d31b9d0614cc3ee4df9ea9165cccf95abe824.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Skyscraper Lighting Changes[/b]
Since the release of the map Skyscraper, we had some problems with the quality of the Lightmaps. We now reworked the lighting for some of the areas and improved the quality of the reflections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/3f7079ff59c983d965089c09d2090f8040b308cf.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Hideout Temporary Removed[/b]
While we already reworked a lot of maps, we want to bring "Hideout" to the same standard as the other maps, so we decided to remove "Hideout" temporarily from the map pool. Hideout will get re-released later in 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/82bb9c36d535f3ee6893661da6a77b2d4470ac4a.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Hitmarker Visual Improvements[/b]
In update 2.2, we also looked at things like the Hitmaker and thought that we can still make some improvements there. So in order to make the Hitmaker more satisfying, we made him a little bit more dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/d40bb6ed6f6f734b36271f5482b3405e497c781c.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Killfeed Improvements[/b]
We found that the abrupt Killfeed is not really up to our usual standards, so we added a dynamic fade to it, to make it look nicer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/f417456e0cacb6a64b553d9399a98edfdf3bd83f.gif[/img]

[*] [b]TDM & DOM (Team) UI Improvements[/b]
We found it really hard to see in what team you are in modes like Domination or Team Deathmatch, so we updated the UI for a better understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/7319a533c2ab867a78344bc3faebe0d030982cc3.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Other smaller changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added boots on the ground ;)
[*] Added End-Screen Chat
[*] New Killstreak Icons
[*] New Nuke Effect (+ Nuke Post Processing)
[*] Improved Minimap (& Removed Flag Icons from it)
[*] Improved the Weapon Materials
[*] Improved Round Start (Game Mode Announcer)
[*] Improved Round Start Countdown UI
[*] Improved Reflections on all maps
[*] Improved Player Model Customisation view
[*] Increased Level cap to 50
[*] Reduced Airstrike Screenshake
[*] Reduced Frag Screenshake
[*] Removed Player Voices
[/list]

[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Of course, in update 2.2, we also fixed a few bugs that got reported since the last patch. If you find some, feel free to join our Discord Server to tell us!

[list]
[*] Syring Icon has the wrong scale in some menus & HUD
[*] Players & Bots can shoot and walk through the Ammo box
[*] Fixed Weapon Descriptions
[/list]

[/list]

notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Soldiers,[/b][/h2]
and thank you for all the feedback from the CTE branch, it showed us that even without an active player base people are willing to help us improve the game! 
In the last post, we also told you that we give away keys for the Supporter Pack for the people that help us find bugs, etc.

[b]The Winners:[/b]
[list]
[*] Nota (Discord Name)
[*] Gilbert (Discord Name)
[/list]
Those two will get their keys via Discord and again a special thanks to everyone who helped us!

We also have a great announcement for today, [u][b]Vengeance 2.1 is live[/b][/u] right now!

[b]Download Size (Windows): 2.5GB
Download Size (Linux): 2.5GB[/b]

[previewyoutube=ziuhRORiYFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Engine Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed Unity version to 2021.1[/b]
We've updated our engine version from Unity 2020.3 to unity 2021.1 to get more features out of the current URP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/9157ac0dba29cdba613f21f74ada4b3fe0acec2c.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]New Content[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Added New Weapon  "UMP"[/b]
The UMP was designed in the 1990s by Heckler & Koch, as a cheaper, lighter alternative to the MP5, which made heavy use of polymers. The UMP first entered production in 2000 and is now playable in Vengeance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/06328d12d8343517cd678702bd71c3d8a1f9e6b9.jpg[/img]

[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a Better Round End Screen transition[/b]
We thought the way the matches end is way too hard of a cut, so we added a new fade to every ending round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/efc6141aabde4063c5dbe30f01a1da45b163e142.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added Killstreak Tracker[/b]
You now have a way to see how many kills you are away from every killstreak.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/2108be2c13455527f2b18aef61c84edec5ab5261.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Changed Medal Design[/b]
We thought that it is hard to identify what every medal stands for because of that we changed them. They should also fit with our current art direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/948eb820d71d86af49712a34e31f394d4db482e0.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Changed Level Icons[/b]
We thought the old red level icons weren't fitting for the current art direction we are aiming for and because of that, we changed them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/d9f163a7f8158f881b02ade6a6779384a42ced0b.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Changed Gun Game Logic[/b]
You now need two kills per gun and the round ends after reaching the time limit.
You also get random attachments on every weapon now!

[*] [b]Changed Scopes for AKM, AKs[/b]
Some of the weapon scopes were blocked by the iron sight so we changed some of the scopes to fix that.

[*] [b]Changed Frag Behavior[/b]
We felt that the frag grenades were a bit too bouncy so we reduced the bounciness and changed a few other values.

[*] [b]Changed some objects on Raid[/b]
We found out that some of the models used for the map Raid are very unoptimized so we replaced them.

[*] [b]Improved Famas Ironsight[/b]
We found out that players have problems with the current Famas Ironsight because of that, we gave the Famas a new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9480498/9cb9d7ee3cf46ede1120fc79649f3e4afefdf778.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2][b]And More![/b][/h2]
We have a lot of other stuff we are working on! Feel free to check it out!

Projekt Z is an atmospheric First-Person Zombie Co-Op-Shooter set in WW2. In this game, you get to play different characters, who have very different abilities, to find out more about the secrets of the german island you all crashed on.

notes.title: Roadmap 2021 & Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Soldiers,[/b][/h1]

First of all, we wish all of you a happy new year. Stay healthy and enjoy 2021 by playing a few new games! At the moment we are hard working on a lot of stuff, from Vengeance to Projekt Z! But in this post, we want to focus a bit on Vengeance.

[h3][u][b]Road to Vengeance Update 2.0.0[/b][/u][/h3]

Maybe some of you think that we are done with the support of Vengeance but that's not right. At the moment we are working on the Xbox version and the 2.0 version of Vengeance. We think even if we have no players currently playing on a daily basis, it is fun to play against bots.
The plan is to give Vengeance a big overhaul in some parts like UI/UX, Maps, Weapons, etc. 
Vengeance 2.0 will be a normal Vengeance update (so it's completely free for existing customers). We are planning to release update 2.0 in Q2 of 2021.

[u][b]The QA & Support for Vengeance Update 2.0.0[/b][/u]

Vengeance Update 2.0 will be released on PC (Windows, Linux) and Xbox, which means that we have to test the game a lot on other platforms. With Vengeance 2.0 we want to focus a lot more on the Linux build than before because we think that that was the biggest problem in the last versions we've released. The testing OS for that is Ubuntu because according to steam data it is the most used OS on Linux for Vengeance.
The support of vengeance after version 2.0 depends on the success of the update, if we see that people are enjoying the game as much as we do more content updates will be released. notes.title: About Version 0.6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9480498/f1e1aeacb04bd38d9c33a01d4bdfcefc9979bc62.png[/img]
[h1][b]~The silence has been broken~[/b][/h1]

It has been a long, long time since you last heard from us but we asserted that this game will be finished.
Today is the day! Not the update release day but it won't be another year until this update hits the light of day.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Se2A3wBLIL8

[h1]Technical changes[/h1]
Due to the unavailability of servers, we chose to change our networking to a more battle proven and known one.
The biggest advantage is that this change and many others mean a huge performance increase and no more connection issues to games.
However, worry not!
We won't be changing the core gameplay very much, however, there are certain team-based features that will be removed.
Since Vengeance, in its core, is a one-man game, these features do not make much sense and will be replaced by other, more one-man oriented features.
Classes, more specifically the "medic" and "supporter" have been removed. Every player will now spawn with a one-time heal utility ("syringe").
The absence of the so called "supporter" will probably not be noticed, however, it will be replaced by ammo crates that are placed on every map which can be used to restock your ammo.
Ammo drops by players will stay but give less ammo. They will be supplemented by medikits that work in a similar manner.

[h1]Map changes[/h1]
In our absence, we have not been doing nothing. Our quality level in terms of map graphical fidelity has drastically improved. That, however, means all maps will be removed and replaced by new ones. Currently, we are working on 5 different maps with different layouts. The first map is also still a work in progress so you can give us some feedback there.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9480498/8476f4f9d003dac3d1b36f2ca6a79400e07ded2d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
Vengeance's armory will be supplemented where it was lacking. Heavy guns and more shotguns. Here are some examples:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9480498/f49c5f835b3652100ef37a66e811a2f1765ab039.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9480498/7ce6e8eb75c5677e958236140d1f649aed8e9375.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9480498/208e11a35b068b8953b37de7615dff53880eeef1.png[/img]

[h1]User Interface[/h1]
All new user interface. We can't show you anything yet - but let us assure you it will be much more streamlined and less complicated.



See you!
